findings.title: SQL injection vulnerability in find_users_by_name
findings.explanation: The function builds an SQL query by directly interpolating the user-provided 'name' parameter into the query string using an f-string. This allows an attacker to inject malicious SQL code, leading to potential data leakage or modification.

evidence.quote: query = f"SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'"

limitations: No supporting code was provided, so we cannot assess how find_users_by_name is integrated or whether input validation is performed elsewhere.
missing_inputs: No supporting code was provided; only the diff is visible.
